result.summary: Found 1 issue: a promotional discount badge on a restaurant card displays a nonsensical value.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a badge reading '-0%', which indicates a zero or missing discount value. This looks like a data/formatting bug rather than a valid promotion.
issues.suggestion: Show an actual discount percentage (e.g., -20%) or use a different label such as '€0 delivery'; remove the badge if no promotion applies.
